name: Apply Ceiling Finish (Roll Method)
intent: Roll finish coat onto primed ceiling with an 18-inch roller on extension pole. No cut-in module — ceiling finish doesn't cut in to walls because the ceiling-to-wall line is established by the wall painter cutting in to the ceiling later. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between for QT4/5.
doctrine: Ceiling roll finish (280 SF/hr smooth, 220 textured) is ~17% slower than wall roll finish for the same overhead reasons that affect prime. The R1 and R2 rates are identical for ceilings (no second-coat speedup) because overhead work doesn't get easier with experience on the same wall — both passes are equally fatiguing. The wall painter establishes the finish cut line later, so this module has no cut-in task.
